newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market Monday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market Monday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers at the usual Monday standoff, USDA said.

Buyer inquiry was fairly good and opening bids often $105.00-$106.00 per cwt on a dressed basis. Seller interest was light and cattle priced anywhere from $107.00-$109.00. Last sizeable price test was Wednesday at $106.00-$107.00.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
Slaughter Heifers - No reported sales. Confirmed - None Last Week - 2,500 Last Year - 600
Wk To Date- 2,500 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 9,800 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 4,500
